answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 170733 Country: India Title: Is it haram to wear a silver chain for men. Can we perform Salah/Namaz wearing silver chain Question: Is it haram to wear a silver chain for men. Can we perform Salah/Namaz wearing silver chain. Please suggest. Answer ID: 170733 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 833/719/SD=09/1440) It is not lawful for a male to wear silver chain and it is makrooh to offer salah wearing it. ولا يتحلى الرجل بذهب وفضة مطلقا إلا بخاتم ... الخ (شامي، زكريا ديوبند: ج 9، ص 516) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
